avis.texte: I have rosacea on my cheeks and nose. I was resigned to never finding an OTC product that would help with it. I’d tried numerous things that either made the redness worse or produced no noticeable results. I got a tube of Cica Care Balm in a K-beauty box. I figured “why not?” and began using it twice a day on my rosacea spots. I frankly didn’t pay much attention for a while, until one day I looked in the mirror and realized the skin on my nose and cheeks looked...normal. No bumps. No redness. I was floored. I’m on my third tube now and it’s still working. I ended up ordering Rovectin’s Cica Care sleeping pack because I was so encouraged by the results of the balm. Note of warning: Make sure you are buying directly from Rovectin. I got a counterfeit tube through Amazon at one point. The genuine balm should have a slight pinkish tint to it and have a (very light) odor of calamine lotion.

I’m prone to get hormonal acne and struggled with finding an acne cream that didn’t dry my skin out. I went out on a reach and bought some for Christmas it’s been the best thing I have ever used. It’s almost immediate relief. It doesn’t burn my skin like other acne creams and it’s reduces swelling and redness within minutes. I use it morning and night as part of my skin routine. I highly recommend for sensitive skin!

Don’t hesitate to buy this is you have itchy or sensitive skin. The skin on my neck is ultra sensitive and prone to developing a red and itchy rash. This moisturizer is the first one I’ve tried that takes care of that without causing my skin to break out (did I mention it’s prone to breakouts too?). Wonderful cream!

avis.titre: GREAT for super dry skin (other skin types during winter)
avis.texte: This moisturizer is THICC so I LOVE this when I get dehydrated - my skin is always thirsty so on desert-like days this is what I reach for at the end of a routine or during the day if I'm not wearing makeup. It's soothing and has a slight hint of a smell that is pleasant, I'd say bro-dudes might think it's a feminine smell but my guy, think of how soft your skin will feel and get over it - it's that good. Note: It's a balm but I did mean thicc moisturizer - it's not a thicc balm so you wont feel greasy IF you have dry skin. This might be a bit too heavy for oily skin types in the summer or if you aren't dehydrated (oily can be dry so don't ignore your skin's thirst - go with their Lotus Water Cream for a lighter option.

Works overnight. I've tried so many different balms and spot treatments over the years (shudder at Mario badescu drying lotion and Murad, also korean ones that were slightly better but didn't help redness or healing). Not only does it calm down the inflammation of angry blemishes it seems to help with it at all stages of healing so it doesn't literally take a month to go away. Repeat buying. Just wish the price wouldn't go up..

This cream has saved my dry, irritated winter face! It has also helped heal up quicker than usual a couple of hormonal acne break outs I had. The texture is thick but goes on very easily and doesn’t leave any residue; I use it on top of my usual moisturizer morning and evening where I get most redness (t-zone and around my nose). It does not contain any fragrances but it does have lavender oil so it smells very nice.

avis.titre: Works great with all skin types (and smells amazing!)
avis.texte: As a guy in my 20s, there are few skin care products that I've tried and loved. Rovectin CICA is definitely one of them. It has a light cream texture that leaves no residue (no oily look on your face directly after applying) and leaves your skin feeling really soft. Plus, the smell is amazing so it's always a pleasure to put it on. I've only been using it for a couple of weeks but can already see me reordering this next month.

Oh Thank God... I mean Amazon Lol. Finally A product that calms my skin. I would go so far to say that I have the most sensitive skin on the planet but I’m sure others feel the same way. This is a good product. how do I know? So many products irritate and make my situation worse. First it does not irritate so therefore it can get on with the healing. Feels soothing on my skin. I’ve only been using it for two days but plan on keeping the routine (this with a fermentation product.) .can’t wait to see my new skin ,or should I say in my old skin?... The skin that was non-irritating... come back.
Me lo recomendó una médica para el contorno de ojos para ayudar en la cicatrización y segun un efecto de estiramiento. Quizas ayudo en la cicatrización pero de estiramiento no creo.

avis.titre: So good for acne prone skin!
avis.texte: So good to my skin, especially now in the winter. Moisturizer nicely and is kind to my acne prone skin.
I have psoriasis which means I have to be extra careful with products I am using! This balm is pure magic for me. Moisturizes and leaves skin soft!
